title: Chapter 87 The Past
content:
Chapter 87 The Past

As long as Jiang Bei wants, he doesn't even need to do anything, countless forces in the surrounding star fields will come and submit to the Wuling Star Field.

"Wait."

One of them spoke again, and then sat down directly.

Seeing this, everyone around also sat down, waiting for Jiang Bei to come back.

On the other side.

In the Qingling Star Field.

This is Yu Qingfeng's hometown.

It is also the place where Yu Qingfeng rose to prominence in the past. Until now, Yu Qingfeng's legend is still circulating in the Qingling Star Field.

"One person fought six powerful gods alone, and finally reached the peak and reached the realm of the Lord of Gods. From then on, there was no rival in the world!"

"If Yu Qingfeng hadn't been born, the road would have been like a long night!"

"There are so many geniuses and evildoers in the world, but they are not as good as one of his fingers."

"Wow! He is so powerful, so how is he now?"

Under the stage, a little boy with stars in his eyes spoke excitedly.

Hearing this, the old man on the stage was stunned, and a trace of sadness suddenly appeared on his face.

"Alas, God is jealous of talents."

The old man shook his head and did not answer this question.

Hearing this, the little boy's expression suddenly collapsed, but then the little boy clenched his hands and said in a childish tone: "I want to be a person like Yu Qingfeng in the future."

As soon as the voice fell, a broad palm fell on the little boy's shoulder.

"You can learn from him, but forget about becoming a person like him. Just be yourself."

Hearing the voice, the little boy turned his head blankly and saw a middle-aged man with pale hair.

Looking at the appearance of the middle-aged man, the little boy was stunned, and then nodded.

At this time on the stage, the old man was already in tears.

"You,"

At this time, Yu Qingfeng looked up at the old man and smiled slightly, "Teacher, I'm back."

Tens of millions of years have passed, and everything has changed.

The little kid who used to run after him every day has now become a top-level expert in the star field.

Respected by thousands of people.

Inside the house.

The old man sat opposite Yu Qingfeng.

"That incident was my fault. I shouldn't have..."

The old man said slowly, but before he finished speaking, Yu Qingfeng interrupted him.

"Teacher, it's not your fault. I shouldn't blame you."

Then, Yu Qingfeng stood up and walked to the side, bowing deeply to the old man.

"Teacher, I've let you down all these years."

Looking at Yu Qingfeng at this time, the old man's eyes were wet. For tens of millions of years, that incident was not only Yu Qingfeng's knot, but also his.

Back then, he was also a powerful man in the Wuling star field, with a great reputation.

Later, he met a talented young man, and on a whim, he accepted him as his apprentice and taught him martial arts.

The young man lived up to his expectations and soon became a good strong man.

Since then, he has been very fond of the boy and once regarded him as his pride.

He would brag about how extraordinary his beloved disciple was almost everywhere he went.

However, an accident happened suddenly.

One day, when he was in seclusion, the boy went out for training, was attacked, and finally died tragically in the hands of an evil force, and his soul was refined by the other party.

Upon learning of this, he was immediately furious. In a fit of rage, he ignored the dissuasion of others and directly wiped out everyone in the sect of that force.

But that evil force was also very powerful. Although he destroyed its power, he was also injured. Coupled with the extreme sadness of losing his beloved disciple, his realm began to decline continuously.

Finally, he came here in despair and became a teacher from then on.

Until later, he met Yu Qingfeng when he was young.

"Teacher, teacher, they say that I can only study and am a waste. Is this true?"

"Yes, it is true."

"Ah? Then what else can I do besides studying?"

"You can also practice."

"Practice? I don't know how."

"I'll teach you."

Since then, in addition to studying with the old man on weekdays, Yu Qingfeng would occasionally practice under the guidance of the old man.

Until one day, the old man suddenly discovered that Yu Qingfeng was a peerless genius.

After a long period of careful consideration, the old man decided to formally introduce Yu Qingfeng to the way of practice.

Because burying such a genius, the old man really couldn't bear it.

However, although he taught Yu Qingfeng to practice, he never allowed Yu Qingfeng to call him master, only teacher.

This time, it was a two-way redemption.

Yu Qingfeng became a well-known top powerhouse in the entire Qingling Star Region.

And he also walked out of the fog of the year.

I thought everything would go well.

Unfortunately, God once again played a huge joke on this poor man.

Yu Qingfeng has a childhood sweetheart here.

Even he envied their relationship.

Later, Yu Qingfeng embarked on the path of cultivation and left this small place. Because the woman had no talent for cultivation, in order not to drag Yu Qingfeng down, the woman chose to stay here.

"Qingfeng, you can go with peace of mind. Here, I, the old man, am guarding, so you can rest assured."

Although his cultivation has declined and is not as good as it used to be, he is definitely not weak.

"Qingfeng, I will wait for you at home. When you come back, we will get married, okay?"

The woman smiled at Yu Qingfeng, but her eyes were a little wet.

As long as she opened her mouth, Yu Qingfeng would never step out of here, but she couldn't.

Even if she was reluctant.

"Luo Li, when I come back, I will definitely come back to marry you."

"Master, Luo Li is in your hands, you must protect her."

Yu Qingfeng left.

That day, Luo Li stood there looking at the direction where Yu Qingfeng left for a whole day.

Time flies.

Yu Qingfeng finally came back.

But what he faced was a cold tombstone.

The tomb of Yu Qingfeng's wife, Luo Li.

"Qingfeng, I'm sorry, I..."

Looking at Yu Qingfeng kneeling in front of the tombstone, crying in despair, the old man felt extremely guilty.

Luo Li was killed by Yu Qingfeng's enemies outside.

And that day, he was in seclusion to heal his wounds.

"Go away, I don't want to see you again."

Yu Qingfeng suppressed his inner emotions and gritted his teeth.

Yu Qingfeng hated him for not protecting Luo Li.

Since then, Yu Qingfeng cried here for three days and three nights, and cried from a handsome young man to a middle-aged man with gray hair.

Later, Yu Qingfeng left.

Leaving Qingling Star Region, he never came back.

And the three words "Yu Qingfeng" have completely become a legend in Qingling Star Region.

"It's good to come back, it's good to come back."

The old man patted Yu Qingfeng's shoulder, his eyes moist, "It's just that..."

Luo Li will never come back again.

As if seeing what the old man was thinking, Yu Qingfeng smiled and said, "Teacher, I came back this time to tell you that Luo Li will be back soon."

Hearing this, the old man trembled all over and looked at Yu Qingfeng in a daze.

He knew that Yu Qingfeng would never joke with Luo Li.

But this is really incredible!

How could it be possible to come back to life?

Yu Qingfeng did not explain, but took the old man outside.

At this time, Lu Daosheng and Jiang Bei were sitting outside waiting.

"Who are these two?"

The old man was shocked when he saw Lu Daosheng and the other person.

He could not see through the two people. He felt the breath of one person a little bit, which was extremely terrifying.

The other person could not feel the breath at all, but the more so, the more unusual it was.

"Teacher, this is my friend, Jiang Bei."

Jiang Bei stood up and bowed to the old man.

"I am Jiang Bei, from the Wuling Star Domain."

Although the other party's cultivation is not as good as his, he is the teacher of his friend, so he should give him the face he deserves.

Hearing this, the old man also said: "I am Kong Wen, Qingfeng's master."

At this time, Kong Wen was recalling in his mind.

Jiang Bei, why is this name so familiar?

Oh, by the way, isn't the martial god of the Wuling Star Domain called this name?

Wait, this guy seems to say that he is also from Wuling Star Region.

Could it be? !

Kong Wen immediately stared at Jiang Bei in shock.
